recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is; no FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-22144 unless a future work-group decision changes the allowed performer actor targets.
issue_request: FHIR-22144 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core ImagingStudy and requested adding HealthcareService to ImagingStudy.series.performer.actor because the actor already allowed CareTeam and Organization.
initial_application: Commit e64cab69affa7913fed6bd2f23cfe30728893ab2 explicitly included GF#22144 and added HealthcareService to the original ImagingStudy performer actor reference list in source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy-spreadsheet.xml. The 2021 source refactor commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 introduced structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml and retained HealthcareService.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ImagingStudy as an active resource assigned to II. A 2019 Zulip Pattern Development thread records the same rationale from Grahame Grieve: if CareTeam and Organization can perform an ImagingStudy, HealthcareService should be able to as well. Sibling Jira FHIR-22145 concerns Observation and DiagnosticReport performers and was not decided here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The final combined-branch commit is an empty audit commit because source/imagingstudy/structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml already includes HealthcareService in the targetProfile list for ImagingStudy.series.performer.actor.

related_jiras.note: Sibling HealthcareService performer request for Observation and DiagnosticReport surfaced in the same rationale, but it affects separate OO artifacts and was not decided here.
